title: Run Software Factory Phase 3 ephemeral subagent dispatch MVP
summary: Prove that the Software Factory orchestration layer can dispatch bounded ephemeral role agents from a run packet, collect worker results, manually integrate, verify, and produce owner-reviewable evidence without persistent agents or PXS/Vega interference.

body.scope: Delivery-owned Software Factory control artifact: worker result contract and dispatch evidence.
body.close_when: At least three ephemeral role workers are dispatched, worker results are collected, one Delivery-owned contract artifact is integrated, validation passes, and evidence identifies the next control object.

product_scope: delivery / task-management / control-panel as safe target family
requested_action: Execute the Phase 3 dispatch MVP with ephemeral subagents only.
success_signal: A validated run shows bounded role dispatch, result summaries, manual integration, independent verification, and owner-reviewable evidence.
proposed_action: Execute the Phase 3 dispatch MVP with ephemeral subagents only.
